reviews.text: FiFi & Fidos has a good selection of some of the best nutritious dog and cat food on the market today! Diana, the owner, is very knowledgeable and is always happy to help.

If you’re looking for an amazing store with great staff who are so knowledgeable and helpful - you have to try Fifi and Fido! My dogs each have individual issues but ever since getting their food from here, it’s been night and day difference. The staff remember who you are and take the time to help educate you. Will always recommend to friends and family. Thanks Fifi & Fido! 🙏
Thanks so much for the great review! We really appreciate the feedback and are really happy that you were pleased with our store!
Thank you for the great review! We really appreciate it 🩷 …
Great place and customer service. These folks are very knowledgeable in cat and dogs.

Amazing service from a truly kind, locally owned pet store. We came in right after adopting our rescue pup, Lotte and the staff went above and beyond to make us all feel welcome. Thoughtful recommendations, zero pressure, and lots of attention for our new family member. Highly recommend supporting Fifi & Fidos Pet Boutique.
For all you pet lovers, this is the place to shop

What a wonderful locally-owned small business! Very friendly service consistently. Excellent products. The owner is a veritable fountain of wisdom when it comes to pets. High quality products and grooming. I love this store and have been a customer for years.
Very cute little shop with loads of treats and goodies for pets. Stopped in to grab a little something nice for our dog and she devoured them!

Always helpful, knowledgeable, professional and friendly. A large variety of healthy pet food choices, supplements, and toys. A Pup Above, Steve's, Answers, My Perfect Pet, Small Batch, Super Food, Goat Milk and more. Lightly cooked and raw. Birthday Cookies or get one when it's not their birthday. Natural healthy treats. Save those teeth with all natural products. Adored Beast is a favorite line of healthy supplements. Natural shampoo. Healthy kibble. I buy Carna 4. They have a very good variety of everything. Just asked them about the food and they will guide you on your best choices. They saved my dogs life after 6 weeks with gastrointestinal issues. Very knowledgeable on pet nutrition and diets. All reasonably priced. Some products are rewarded with purchase consistently. You get one free. I've been shopping there at least 12 years.

This place is so amazing! They have a great variety of high quality foods and items for our pets and are so welcoming and friendly! You must check this place out and grab a treat for your furry friends!

I stumbled upon this store while running errands in the neighborhood, and I couldn’t be happier that I did! I picked up some fur care vitamins for my cats and was pleasantly surprised to receive a bag of goodies along with my purchase. It included treats, catnip, wet food, and oils, all neatly packed in a cute pink bag. My first visit was such a positive experience, and I’ll definitely be coming back!
Whole staff is extremely knowledgeable,  and very professional.
Thank you for your review
Thank you for the review! We appreciate your business!

This is the GOAT of a magnificent pet care, food, supplements, snacks ….. absolutely everything. But the best is definitely the owner and her staff that take the time to hear the needs of customers and respond with several chooses making sure the customer knows the pros and cons of products. Who does that? I went with my Mother-in-Law a long time neighbor of the owner and I was blown away at how much this little store packs a whallop. I’m now going to check out their shipping policies! They had cleanly sourced duck topper that I have not been able to find! Highly recommended. Such a wealth of knowledge and customer service.

I love this store. They have products I would not find at any other pet store. The owner and associates are always very knowledgeable and will answer any questions you may have. Everyone is always so very friendly and welcoming. I absolutely love that I can find so many holistic and organic products for my dogs, that are actually healthy for them. Just a great store.

I am writing this review to address the male employee to "Do Better" when dealing with customers of color and to be considerate that some customers have medical disabilities that one might not understand. My mother who is a retired veteran and a foster mother to over 100 children during her Army Career has medals suffered traumatic brain injury and has memory issues. My mother has come in with her dogs and felt uneasy when paying since she locks her account due to her memory issues and is often awkward when speaking due to her medicine and such. I am one of those foster kids she adopted and saved. So this review is very personal to me. My mom should never feel uncomfortable anywhere and often people are not patient with her and the anxiety and awkwardness she has when unlocking her phone and feeling rushed. To the guy who works there Do Better. Mom deserves that she served 22 years and is 51dealing with life long issues.

I have been getting my dogs food from Fifi and Fidos for over 3 years now. He is partially raw fed and they are very knowledgeable in both raw feed brands/options as well as the kibble brands and the brands transparency about product sourcing.
They are very friendly and open to questions. AlI absolutely recommend them time and again!

Needed to run in to grab some food and wish I would have waited until I found somewhere else. I saw a cockroach within the first few minutes of being in the store and then saw another a little while later. Just gross. The owner was also talking very loudly about chewing milk which just added insult to injury. Petsmart is better than this nonsense.
Thank you so much for your review!

I have been shopping here for at least 2 years. This is a small shop with lots to offer. I usually go for the dog toys, treats, and supplements but they do have many other things as well. The staff are always helpful and friendly. The place is very clean and easy to walk through and shop.
The staff here are so helpful!! Diana and Nick were super nice. My roomate and I have a German Sheppard and she LOVED the baked treats.

When my Corgi got cancer, I was blessed to find the knowledgeable owner and staff of Fifi and Fido's who made his final days as healthy and comfortable as possible. Now I feed all of my pets the "medicine" of quality raw food and catered supplements from Fifi and Fido's!
Thank you so much for the review! Come back to see us soon!
Supplements, raw, interactive toys oh my! Everything you need to elevate your pets wellbeing.
